literal_meaning: দ্বি (দুই) + অর্থ (অর্থ) + হীন (হীন) – দুই অর্থের অভাবী
figurative_meaning_bn: দুইপ্রকার অর্থ হয় না এমন, স্পষ্টভাষায়
figurative_meaning_en: Devoid of double meanings, expressed in straightforward language
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার বক্তব্য দ্ব্যর্থহীন ছিল, সকলে বুঝতে পারল।
example_sentences_in_english: His statement was unambiguous, and everyone understood it clearly.
The contract is written in straightforward language without any ambiguity.
note: This term is more of a linguistic descriptor than a traditional folk idiom, rooted in Sanskrit-derived vocabulary common in Bengali formal expression.
